tests.name: First automatic launch opens the setup wizard before ordinary library navigation
Only safe basenames supported books and bounded sizes can start an upload
Chunk offsets size and session ID protect order and boundaries
Existing books and symlink targets cannot be overwritten
Cancellation removes incomplete temporary files without a visible partial book
Failed cleanup retains its temporary path and retries before accepting another file
Directory traversal symlink roots and file roots are rejected
Insufficient free space is rejected before creating a temporary file
Write failures remain cancellable and do not publish a partial book
One-time wizard can be skipped without moving files or changing the existing root
Configured destination persists and synchronizes the library without moving source books
Settings header uses More and its two shortcuts preserve scoped search and restart
Transfer settings are discoverable from both categories and global search
Upload endpoints reject missing authorization foreign origins and hosts
HTTP framing rejects smuggling duplicate length fields oversize and unauthorized headers early
Successful HTTP upload commits exactly once and schedules a real library refresh
Temporary firewall rules are scoped and rolled back after partial setup failure
Idle uploads and expired sessions close without leaving partial data
Suspend stops listening invalidates the token and deletes partial data
Changing the library root synchronizes transfer preferences and closes old sessions
